headline: 蜘蛛侠新日领跑，暑期档热度攀升
headlineEn: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leads Summer Box-Office Buzz
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片入市。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》继续霸榜，《奥德赛》《超级少女》热度紧随。业界关注后续《The Last Sunrise》《오케이 마담 2》《逃出绝命街》等新作。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today, with only 3 new releases this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day remains the top trend, followed closely by Odyssey and Supergirl. Industry attention turns to upcoming titles like The Last Sunrise, Okay Madam 2, and Escape the Dead-End Street.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，本周共3部新片入市。
industryHighlights.en: No new films released today; 3 new films hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》持续霸榜，热度居高不下。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to dominate the trending charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《奥德赛》与《超级少女》形成第二梯队，关注度稳步上升。
industryHighlights.en: Odyssey and Supergirl form the second tier with steadily rising buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 多部新片蓄势待发，包括《The Last Sunrise》《오케이 마담 2》《逃出绝命街》。
industryHighlights.en: Several upcoming titles are generating anticipation, including The Last Sunrise, Okay Madam 2, and Escape the Dead-End Street.
